classification.difficultyReason: Plot three supplied parallel rules on common axes and read equal gradients; routine familiar plotting and comparison.

children.label: a
children.prompt: On a single set of axes, draw the graphs of:

spec.description: One blank common-plane response grid, no plotted answers or chosen axes.

answer.worked: For $y=3x$, plot $(-1,-3),\ (0,0),\ (1,3)$. Draw this line on the shared axes using the stated style.
For $y=3x+2$, plot $(-1,-1),\ (0,2),\ (1,5)$. Draw this line on the shared axes using the stated style.
For $y=3x-1$, plot $(-1,-4),\ (0,-1),\ (1,2)$. Draw this line on the shared axes using the stated style.

spec.description: Exact given linear rules on one common Cartesian plane; editable prose style keys identify every line. Exterior tick-label rails preserve all coordinate values.

children.label: b
children.prompt: State the gradient of each of the graphs in part a.

answer.worked: For a one-unit increase in x, every line increases y by 3; equivalently each coefficient of x is 3.
